# Roadbook Nav

> Free, offline-first digital roadbook for motorcycle rally, enduro and trail riding. Plan waypoints on a map at home, export one JSON file, and navigate on your phone with one large direction arrow and a live distance countdown — no mobile signal, no account, no tracking.

Roadbook Nav is a progressive web app (PWA) that runs in any modern browser and can be installed to the home screen on Android and iOS.

## Key facts

- Navigation runs fully offline once the app is installed: no map tiles, no network requests while riding. Distance is computed from GPS with the Haversine formula.
- The route editor needs internet (OpenStreetMap tiles) and is meant to be used before the ride.
- Each waypoint has a turn arrow (straight, slight/normal/sharp left or right, U-turn, start, finish) and an optional label.
- Auto-advance trigger radius: 15, 25 (default) or 50 m.
- Feedback at each waypoint: audio cues and vibration (vibration is not available on iOS Safari).
- GPX files can be loaded as an overlay; waypoint clicks snap onto the track.
- Multiple route variants per device; JSON import and export.
- Data stays on the device (localStorage and exported files). No account, no server, no location sharing.
- Not a turn-by-turn road navigator and does not show a moving map while navigating.
- Price: free.
